Management Plan

- Clinical impression: Likely viral upper respiratory tract infection/early influenza.  
- Advice provided:
  • Rest; consider 1–2 days off work.  
  • Maintain adequate hydration.  
  • Continue symptomatic relief with paracetamol and/or ibuprofen as needed.  
  • Monitor for red-flag symptoms (persistent/high fever, increasing breathlessness, chest pain); seek review sooner if these occur.  
- Follow-up: Review in 1 week if no improvement.  
- No immediate investigations, prescriptions, or referrals planned today.
